name: Reolink Doorbell
description: Live video and two-way audio with a wired or PoE Reolink doorbell, straight from the doorbell over RTSP. Opens on its own when the doorbell rings, using Home Assistant's visitor sensor, and can open the door through a Home Assistant lock. No go2rtc or restreamer needed.
author: OC

buttons.title: Test connection
buttons.label: Test
buttons.description: Logs in to the doorbell's HTTP API and reads its model and firmware. Does not start video.

settings.title: Doorbell address
settings.description: IP or hostname of the doorbell, for example 192.168.1.50. Give it a fixed IP in your router.

settings.title: Username
settings.description: A Reolink user on the doorbell. A dedicated user for the kiosk is best.

settings.title: Stream
settings.description: sub is lighter and starts faster; main is full resolution and may be too heavy for small tablets.

settings.title: RTSP port
settings.description: Enable RTSP in the Reolink app under Network > Advanced > Port settings.

settings.title: Show diagnostics
settings.description: Shows connection time, keyframe wait, codecs and the decoder in the viewer. Errors always show.

settings.title: Channel
settings.description: 0 for a doorbell connected directly. Only change it when connecting through a Reolink NVR.

settings.title: Visitor sensor
settings.description: The doorbell's visitor binary sensor from Home Assistant's Reolink integration. Leave empty to only open the viewer manually.

settings.title: Open the viewer when it rings
Wake the screen when it rings
Image sizing
settings.description: Fit shows the whole picture; Fill crops to the screen; Stretch fills without preserving proportions.

settings.title: Two-way audio
settings.description: The green phone opens the tablet's microphone and sends it to the doorbell over its ONVIF RTSP backchannel. Kiosk Satellite needs microphone permission.

settings.title: Door lock (optional)
settings.description: Shows a blue door button between the call buttons. A tap unlocks the door, or locks it again when it is open, at once and without confirmation.
